provenance: Frozen literal Setting/FIELDS declarations in config-reference order; no Rust execution. Node foundation configuration lives in apps/server/src/config.ts.

fields.name: DATABASE_URL
fields.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Required; never logged.
fields.descriptionZh: PostgreSQL 连接 URL。必填；绝不写入日志。

fields.name: APP_BIND
fields.description: API listener IP address and port.
fields.descriptionZh: API 监听 IP 地址和端口。

fields.name: RUST_LOG
fields.description: Structured log filter.
fields.descriptionZh: 结构化日志过滤器。

fields.name: MIGRATION_TIMEOUT_SECS
fields.description: Migration execution deadline in seconds (1..3600).
fields.descriptionZh: 迁移执行时限，单位秒（1..3600）。

fields.name: APP_ORIGIN
fields.description: Trusted browser origin. HTTPS required except loopback development.
fields.descriptionZh: 受信任的浏览器来源。除本机回环开发外必须为 HTTPS。

fields.name: SESSION_ABSOLUTE_SECS
fields.description: Absolute session lifetime in seconds (60..2592000).
fields.descriptionZh: 会话绝对有效期，单位秒（60..2592000）。

fields.name: SESSION_IDLE_SECS
fields.description: Idle session lifetime in seconds (60..absolute lifetime).
fields.descriptionZh: 会话空闲有效期，单位秒（60..绝对有效期）。

fields.name: S3_ENDPOINT
fields.description: Internal S3 endpoint at its root path. Unset disables object storage.
fields.descriptionZh: 内部 S3 端点（根路径）。未设置时禁用对象存储。

fields.name: S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT
fields.description: Browser-accessible S3 origin. Defaults to S3_ENDPOINT; HTTPS except loopback.
fields.descriptionZh: 浏览器可访问的 S3 来源。默认取 S3_ENDPOINT；除本机回环外必须为 HTTPS。

fields.name: S3_BUCKET
fields.description: Dedicated private application bucket.
fields.descriptionZh: 应用专用的私有存储桶。

fields.name: S3_REGION
fields.description: S3 signing region.
fields.descriptionZh: S3 签名区域。

fields.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY
fields.description: Explicit S3 access key; required when S3_ENDPOINT is set.
fields.descriptionZh: 显式 S3 访问密钥；设置 S3_ENDPOINT 时必填。

fields.name: S3_SECRET_KEY
fields.description: Explicit S3 secret; required when enabled, never logged.
fields.descriptionZh: 显式 S3 私密密钥；启用对象存储时必填，绝不写入日志。

fields.name: FILE_MAX_BYTES
fields.description: File byte limit, verified again on the final object (1..104857600).
fields.descriptionZh: 文件字节上限，最终对象会再次校验（1..104857600）。

fields.name: UPLOAD_SESSION_SECS
fields.description: Upload resource/signing lifetime in seconds (1..3600).
fields.descriptionZh: 上传资源/签名有效期，单位秒（1..3600）。

fields.name: DOWNLOAD_URL_SECS
fields.description: Download capability lifetime in seconds (1..300). Revocation blocks new signing.
fields.descriptionZh: 下载能力有效期，单位秒（1..300）。撤销后停止新签名。

fields.name: TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT
fields.description: Optional local OTLP/HTTP base URL (loopback or collector); empty disables export.
fields.descriptionZh: 可选的本地 OTLP/HTTP 基础 URL（回环或 collector）；留空禁用导出。

fields.name: TELEMETRY_LOG_DIRECTORY
fields.description: Optional private JSON log directory; hourly rotation with at most 24 files per service. Empty uses stdout.
fields.descriptionZh: 可选的私有 JSON 日志目录；按小时轮转，每个服务最多保留 24 个文件。留空输出到 stdout。

fields.name: TELEMETRY_QUEUE_SIZE
fields.description: Bounded span queue (64..4096); overflow drops telemetry, never blocks requests.
fields.descriptionZh: 有界 span 队列（64..4096）；溢出时丢弃遥测，绝不阻塞请求。

fields.name: TELEMETRY_TIMEOUT_MS
fields.description: Whole OTLP request timeout, one attempt (50..2000 ms).
fields.descriptionZh: OTLP 请求整体超时，单次尝试（50..2000 毫秒）。

fields.name: TELEMETRY_METRICS_INTERVAL_MS
fields.description: Metrics export interval (1000..60000 ms).

fields.name: WORKER_BIND
fields.description: Worker health listener IP address and port.
fields.descriptionZh: Worker 健康检查监听 IP 地址和端口。

fields.name: JOB_LEASE_SECS
fields.description: Job lease lifetime (5..3600 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 任务租约有效期（5..3600 秒）。

fields.name: JOB_HEARTBEAT_SECS
fields.description: Lease renewal interval (1..half the lease seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 租约续期间隔（1..租约秒数的一半）。

fields.name: JOB_SHUTDOWN_SECS
fields.description: Maximum active-work drain before process exit (1..60 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 进程退出前完成在途工作的最长时间（1..60 秒）。

fields.name: JOB_MAINTENANCE_SECS
fields.description: Interval for bounded maintenance scheduling (1..3600 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 有界维护调度的执行间隔（1..3600 秒）。

fields.name: REDIS_URL
fields.description: Optional redis:// connection URL. Unset disables caching; credentials are never logged.
fields.descriptionZh: 可选的 redis:// 连接 URL。未设置时禁用缓存；凭据绝不写入日志。

fields.name: CACHE_PREFIX
fields.description: Deployment cache namespace (1..100 ASCII letters, digits, colon, dash or underscore).
fields.descriptionZh: 部署缓存命名空间（1..100 个 ASCII 字母、数字、冒号、短横线或下划线）。

fields.name: CACHE_TTL_SECS
fields.description: Text cache TTL in seconds (1..3600). PostgreSQL remains the authorization/version source.
fields.descriptionZh: 正文缓存 TTL，单位秒（1..3600）。PostgreSQL 始终是授权与版本的来源。

fields.name: CACHE_BUDGET_MS
fields.description: Total optional Redis budget per read, including lookup/fill (1..1000 milliseconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 每次读取的 Redis 总预算，含查找/回填（1..1000 毫秒）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
fields.description: Enable registration, authentication and general request policies.
fields.descriptionZh: 启用注册、认证和普通请求三类限流策略。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECS
fields.description: Fixed-window duration shared by rate policies (1..3600).
fields.descriptionZh: 各限流策略共享的固定窗口时长（1..3600）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_REGISTRATION
fields.description: Registration requests per TCP peer/window with Redis (1..1000000).
fields.descriptionZh: 启用 Redis 时每个 TCP 对等端/窗口的注册请求数（1..1000000）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_REGISTRATION_FALLBACK
fields.description: Conservative local registration capacity (1..registration capacity).
fields.descriptionZh: 保守的本地注册容量（1..注册容量）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_AUTHENTICATION
fields.description: Credential requests per TCP peer/window with Redis (1..1000000).
fields.descriptionZh: 启用 Redis 时每个 TCP 对等端/窗口的凭据请求数（1..1000000）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_AUTHENTICATION_FALLBACK
fields.description: Conservative local authentication capacity (1..authentication capacity).
fields.descriptionZh: 保守的本地认证容量（1..认证容量）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_RESOURCE
fields.description: Other requests per TCP peer/window with Redis (1..1000000); health probes are excluded.
fields.descriptionZh: 启用 Redis 时每个 TCP 对等端/窗口的其他请求数（1..1000000）；健康探测除外。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_RESOURCE_FALLBACK
fields.description: Conservative local resource capacity (1..resource capacity).
fields.descriptionZh: 保守的本地资源容量（1..资源容量）。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_LOCAL_ENTRIES
fields.description: Maximum local peer/policy buckets (1..100000); overflow shares conservative policy windows.
fields.descriptionZh: 本地对等端/策略桶上限（1..100000）；溢出时共享保守策略窗口。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_PREFIX
fields.description: Redis limiter namespace, isolated from text cache keys.
fields.descriptionZh: Redis 限流命名空间，与正文缓存键隔离。

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_BUDGET_MS
fields.description: Absolute Redis counter operation deadline (1..1000 ms), then local fallback.
fields.descriptionZh: Redis 计数操作的绝对时限（1..1000 毫秒），超时回退本地。

fields.name: MAIL_SMTP_HOST
fields.description: SMTP host. Unset disables password reset delivery; ordinary registration/login remain available.
fields.descriptionZh: SMTP 主机。未设置时停发密码重置邮件；普通注册/登录不受影响。

fields.name: MAIL_SMTP_PORT
fields.description: SMTP port (1..65535); typically 465 wrapper, 587 STARTTLS, 1025 local capture.
fields.descriptionZh: SMTP 端口（1..65535）；常见为 465 wrapper、587 STARTTLS、1025 本地捕获。

fields.name: MAIL_SMTP_TLS
fields.description: wrapper, starttls, or local (only loopback/localhost/mailpit).
fields.descriptionZh: wrapper、starttls 或 local（仅限回环/localhost/mailpit）。

fields.name: MAIL_FROM
fields.description: Validated sender mailbox.
fields.descriptionZh: 经过校验的发件邮箱。

fields.name: MAIL_SMTP_USERNAME
fields.description: Optional SMTP username; requires matching password.
fields.descriptionZh: 可选 SMTP 用户名；必须同时提供密码。

fields.name: MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD
fields.description: Optional SMTP password; never logged.
fields.descriptionZh: 可选 SMTP 密码；绝不写入日志。

fields.name: MAIL_TIMEOUT_SECS
fields.description: Whole SMTP attempt deadline, including TLS/DATA/QUIT (1..300 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: SMTP 单次尝试总时限，含 TLS/DATA/QUIT（1..300 秒）。

fields.name: MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
fields.description: Independent 32-byte hex key for short-lived mail materials; shared by API/Worker, required with SMTP.
fields.descriptionZh: 用于短期邮件材料的独立 32 字节十六进制密钥；API/Worker 共享，配置 SMTP 时必填。

fields.name: MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_VERSION
fields.description: Current positive key version; drain or expire old materials before rotation.
fields.descriptionZh: 当前正整数密钥版本；轮换前需清空或等待旧材料过期。

fields.name: PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECS
fields.description: Reset link lifetime (60..3600 seconds); mail material cannot outlive the link.
fields.descriptionZh: 重置链接有效期（60..3600 秒）；邮件材料不会超过链接有效期。

fields.name: PASSWORD_RESET_COOLDOWN_SECS
fields.description: Coalesce repeated active reset requests for one account (1..300 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 合并同一账号活跃的重置请求（1..300 秒）。

fields.name: LAB_OBSERVATION_RETENTION_SECS
fields.description: Raw observation retention in seconds (1..31536000). Current properties remain unchanged.
fields.descriptionZh: 原始观测保留秒数（1..31536000）。当前逐属性观测保持不变。

fields.name: LAB_RECORD_RETENTION_SECS
fields.description: Ended command/task and device event retention in seconds (1..31536000). Active tasks remain.
fields.descriptionZh: 结束命令、任务和设备事件保留秒数（1..31536000）。保留在途任务。

fields.name: EXPORT_JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS
fields.description: Finite attempt budget per export execution batch (1..20).
fields.descriptionZh: 每个导出执行批次的有限尝试预算（1..20）。

fields.name: EXPORT_MAX_ATTACHMENTS
fields.description: Maximum attachments in one document export (0..1000).
fields.descriptionZh: 单次文档导出的附件数量上限（0..1000）。

fields.name: EXPORT_MAX_INPUT_BYTES
fields.description: Maximum snapshot Markdown and attachment bytes (1..1073741824).
fields.descriptionZh: 快照 Markdown 与附件的总字节上限（1..1073741824）。

fields.name: EXPORT_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
fields.description: Maximum ZIP extent, including headers and central directory (1024..1107296256).
fields.descriptionZh: ZIP 总大小上限，含文件头与中央目录（1024..1107296256）。

fields.name: EXPORT_RETENTION_SECS
fields.description: Export and snapshot lifetime (60..604800 seconds).
fields.descriptionZh: 导出结果与快照的保存期（60..604800 秒）。

fields.name: EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SECS
fields.description: Entire export execution budget (1..600 seconds), with cooperative blocking cancellation.
fields.descriptionZh: 导出执行的整体预算（1..600 秒），支持协作式阻塞取消。
